note.summary: This chunk lists directory links to HMRC tools and calculators grouped by tax area (PAYE, Pensions, Self Assessment, Self-employed, SDLT, VAT). The Self Assessment section links to a tool for estimating a Self Assessment tax bill, a Lloyd's calculator for section 107 Finance Act 2000 adjustments, and a tool to work out transition profit for the 2023 to 2024 tax year under Basis Period Reform. A Self-employed section links to a tool checking which taxes a sole trader may need to register for.

note.summary: This is a directory page listing HMRC's online tools and calculators grouped by tax type, including Alcohol Duty, Capital Allowances, Capital Gains Tax, Corporation Tax, Income Tax, Inheritance Tax and National Insurance. A few entries are directly relevant to Self Assessment: a Capital Gains Tax adjustment calculator for reporting disposals after a mid-year rate change, an overlap relief calculator for the self-employed/partnerships, a filing and payment deadlines checker, and Income Tax estimators for current and previous years. Most other tools (Alcohol Duty, Corporation Tax, Inheritance Tax, gambling duties, import/export) are unrelated to individual Self Assessment filing.
